source_integrity.summary: ENISA 2026, CERT-EU September 2026, Reuters 2 November 2026, Polish ministry, Mandiant, IMF and EU Council materials directly compared with dated primary web reports and article claims; remaining bibliography subject to sampling limitations.

factual_methodology.summary: Refrigeration incident responsibility remains explicitly unknown; December 2025 Poland attempted destructive cyber operation is differentiated from a blackout; aggregate samples do not become population incidence or probabilities; observed vs conjectural motives separated.

source_vintage_and_cutoff.summary: Cutoff 2 November 2026, with same-day breaking news flagged provisional; September 2026 ENISA report covers 2025, Mandiant investigations cover 2025 and Polish energy case occurred in December 2025.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: 16 numbered substantive chapters, distinct political economy and social-psychological focus relative to earlier 21 October cyber/AI report; coherent causal mechanism and source attribution.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Both locales contain three substantive tables, two numeric charts with identical series [32,8,8,7,6] and [32,11,10], one flow chain and one geo exposure map with express geographic-precision limitation; no invented values.

research_depth.summary: Four thousand substantive words per locale; 16 chapters covering history, industrial OT, latest Europe, non-Europe, economics, finance, societal psychology, propaganda, AI, civilian law and five falsifiable scenario paths.

evidence_traceability.summary: Both editions contain the same 23 source URLs. Principal numerical and current-incident claims spot-checked with source pages; not every bibliography URL independently opened in the same verification session.

bilingual_parity.summary: Both versions have 16 matching numbered sections, 23 identical unique URLs, matching visual structure and chart figures; material conclusions and cautionary evidence parallel.

counterfactual_review.summary: Five alternative future paths with disconfirming indicators; independent causes and unknown attribution for refrigeration attacks, no Polish blackout and AI limitations used as contrary evidence.

contrary_evidence: Poland reported continued electricity supply after the destructive December 2025 attempts; cyber access and attempted harm do not establish national blackout.
Reuters reports on 2 November 2026 did not establish a perpetrator or forensic linkage among national supermarket refrigeration incidents.
ENISA and CERT-EU use defined, nonrepresentative incident universes; their percentages cannot be added or converted into global attack probabilities.
Mandiant finds most observed successful intrusions still exploited human and systemic weaknesses, despite new AI-enabled attack workflows.
EEAS FIMI incident/channel counts do not show that voters changed their behavior or that an election outcome was altered.
limitations: Same-day November 2 reports are provisional; attribution, store counts, financial losses and technical linkage require independent forensic revision.
Source incident data and vendor investigations are selected observational samples with distinct denominators and disclosure biases.
Russian, Chinese and other official attributions are identified as institutional statements, not blanket proofs across unrelated incidents.
Forward scenarios for 2027–2030 are conditional and have no defensible precise probability.
A prior general Marginal Thinking cyberwarfare-and-AI study exists; this research focuses on new civilian, economic, psychological and European incident dynamics.
Independent academic peer review was not performed; web spot-check was selective, while programmatic structural and SHA validation covered all source files.
Full npm build could not be executed in this environment because remote repository checkout was unavailable; subsequent GitHub workflow or publisher must validate the deployed bundle.
notes: Separate post-production fact-and-structure QA pass, tied to complete SHA triplet at reviewed main head. No public deployment asserted. Source verification was sampled and limitation recorded explicitly; local clone/npm execution unavailable. Approval is solely for exact immutable pending and staged Markdown snapshots.
